briefTitle: Testing Proton Craniospinal Radiation Therapy Versus the Usual Radiation Therapy for Leptomeningeal Metastasis, RADIATE-LM Trial

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with pathologically (histologically or cytologically) proven diagnosis of breast cancer or NSCLC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Enrollment includes both breast cancer and non-small cell lung cancer, which is multi-histology and not restricted to a single typed NSCLC histology category.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have newly diagnosed leptomeningeal metastasis established through at least one of the following...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Leptomeningeal metastasis diagnostic criteria involve complex clinical, CSF, and radiographic combinations.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must be candidates for radiation therapy for the treatment of leptomeningeal metastasis
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Suitability for radiation therapy is an investigator judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Karnofsky performance status ≥ 60
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Karnofsky performance status is not an ECOG performance status check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Not pregnant and not nursing
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pregnancy and nursing status are standard clinical exclusions not mapped to typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No prior radiation therapy to the spinal cord with equivalent dose in 2 gray (Gy) fractions (EQD2) more than 40Gy or cauda equina with EQD2 more than 50Gy using alpha/beta ratio of 3
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior radiation dose equivalence calculations are complex and cannot be represented by simple typed cutoffs.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No prior treatment for leptomeningeal metastasis (note: prior CNS treatment for other non-leptomeningeal disease is allowed)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior treatment exclusions for leptomeningeal disease are specific and not a standard prior_therapy_excluded drug check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No history of unstable angina requiring hospitalization in the last 3 months
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cardiac history and NYHA functional class are clinical judgment criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No active infection currently requiring intravenous (IV) antibiotic management
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active infection requiring IV antibiotics is a clinical status exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No active chronic obstructive pulmonary disease exacerbation or other acute respiratory illness precluding study therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pulmonary exacerbation status is a clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No CTCAE v5.0 ≥ grade 2 encephalopathy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Encephalopathy grading is a clinical assessment.
